title: A/R Summary Totals equal A/R Detail's Open Balance, bucket by bucket
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role), with location A as your current location.
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, location A and location B, with location A's name first in A to Z order.
  • Make sure you are enrolled at both locations.
  • Have two new customers (created for this test) with only these open documents on today's date:
  • Customer A: an invoice of $1,000.00 at location A that is not yet due, an invoice of $400.00 at location A 45 days past due and an invoice of $300.00 at location B 15 days past due.
  • Customer B: an invoice of $700.00 at location A 45 days past due, partly paid $200.00 (open $500.00), and an invoice of $250.00 at location A 100 days past due.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with customer A and customer B ticked in the Customer filter and Past due on Any.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read the Totals row.
  2. Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) from the Reports menu in a second browser tab.
  3. In the Customer filter, tick customer A.
  4. Tick customer B.
  5. In the Location filter, untick location B.
  6. Switch back to the A/R Summary tab.
  7. In the Location filter, untick location B.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Totals row reads Current $1,000.00, 1-30 Days $300.00, 31-60 Days $900.00 (400.00 + 500.00), 61-90 Days $0.00, 91 And Over $250.00 and Total $2,450.00 (1,000.00 + 300.00 + 900.00 + 250.00).

Step 2:

  • A/R Detail opens on today's date with no customer ticked and Past due on Any.

Step 3:

  • Customer A is ticked.

Step 4:

  • Both are ticked.
  • Each bucket row shows its sums: "91 or more days past due" Open Balance $250.00, "31-60 days past due" Open Balance $900.00 (its Amount reads $1,100.00, the original amounts, which are not compared), "1-30 days past due" $300.00 and "Current" $1,000.00.
  • "61-90 days past due" has no rows.
  • The Totals row's Open Balance reads $2,450.00: bucket by bucket and in total the same as the A/R Summary Totals in step 1.

Step 5:

  • The report narrows to location A: "1-30 days past due" has no rows any more and the Totals row's Open Balance reads $2,150.00 (2,450.00 − 300.00).
  • The other buckets keep their sums.

Step 6:

  • A/R Summary shows, as in step 1.

Step 7:

  • The report narrows to location A: the Totals row reads Current $1,000.00, 1-30 Days $0.00, 31-60 Days $900.00, 61-90 Days $0.00, 91 And Over $250.00 and Total $2,150.00: bucket by bucket the same as A/R Detail in step 5.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R18a: “For the same as-of date, customer or vendor and Location, with Past due on Any, A/R Summary's Totals equal A/R Detail's Open Balance Totals bucket by bucket, and A/P Summary's equal A/P Detail's. The Detail reports' Amount column holds original amounts and is not compared. With a Past due filter they can differ: a Summary keeps the whole row of a customer or vendor that qualifies (Current and credits included), while a Detail report lists only the invoices or bills that qualify, plus every credit.”
  • S5-R18: “The Totals row always adds up exactly the rows the filters leave (customer or vendor, Past due, Location), on screen on every page, in the PDF and in the CSV. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices this fixes today's Totals row, which ignores the customer or vendor filter.”
  • S1-R5: “A/R Detail and A/P Detail keep their aging buckets in this fixed order: "91 or more days past due", "61-90 days past due", "31-60 days past due", "1-30 days past due", "Current". Inside each bucket, rows open in customer or vendor name order (S1-R2 to S1-R4), ties by document number (S2-R4).”
  • S5-R7: “Choosing locations narrows every row, group, subtotal, total, page count, sort and export to the open documents at those locations. A row belongs to the location of its own document. On A/R: the invoice, credit memo or deposit. On A/P: a bill belongs to the location of the delivery it was received on; a vendor credit from a vendor return belongs to that return's location; any other vendor credit keeps its vendor's location, as today. That is the location the Location column shows.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 1 "Opening order and header sorting" (board Main.dc.html); page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p7-past-due-ticked.png: figure "Past due ticked" (New in this build), board "7. Filters and call list"
  • ar-ap-p4-one-location-ticked.png: figure "One location ticked" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"
  • ar-ap-p7-call-list-on-a-r-collection.png: figure "Call list on A/R Collection" (New in this build), board "7. Filters and call list"
  • ar-ap-p1-a-p-aging-detail-as-it-opens-today.png: figure "A/P Aging Detail as it opens today" (Production (before)), board "1. Opening order and header sorting" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "31-60 days and 91+ days ticked: the chip reads "Past due: 2 ranges" in blue. The Summary lists only customers with an amount in those ranges, at full balances; the Totals row adds up exactly these rows. S5-R15, S5-R16, S5-R17, S5-R18, S5-R19." (caption of "Past due ticked")
  • "One location ticked ("1 selected"): the chip names it, rows, totals and exports narrow to it, and the Location column hides. S5-R6, S5-R7, S5-R10, S6-N1." (caption of "One location ticked")
  • "Customer picked: the group row shows "Phone:" and, for users with View and Manage AP/AR Data, "Credit term:". The Totals row follows the customer filter. S9-R1, S9-R2, S5-R18. Exports carry the same lines and columns: S9-R3, S3-R5, S3-R8a." (caption of "Call list on A/R Collection")
  • "Inside a bucket, rows open most overdue first. No sortable headers." (caption of "A/P Aging Detail as it opens today")
